Điều gì sẽ tạo nên bước đột phá tiếp the: What will drive the next breakthrough?
Miền Trung sở hữu những lợi thế chiến lư: Central Vietnam offers strategic advantages in location, port infrastructure, industry, tourism and its local business ecosystem.
Nhưng tiềm năng không tự chuyển hóa thàn: Yet potential alone does not translate into growth. To make a breakthrough, businesses need more than capital: they need technology, management expertise, market access and the right strategic partners.
M&A mở ra một hướng tiếp cận để kết nối: M&A offers a way to bring these resources together, restructure businesses and create new growth. This is the vision behind the Central Vietnam M&A Forum 2026.
